mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_decision ( decision_id, snapshot_id, tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, product_id, project_ref, session_ref, run_id, attempt_id, capability, operation, resource_type, resource_ref, resource_digest, effect, challenge, reason_code, safe_explanation, matched_rule_id, matched_rule_version, request_digest, request_schema_version, request_payload, request_hash, decided_at ) VALUES ( #{row.decisionId}, #{row.snapshotId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.principalId}, #{row.principalType}, #{row.productId}, #{row.projectRef}, #{row.sessionRef}, #{row.runId}, #{row.attemptId}, #{row.capability}, #{row.operation}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.resourceRef}, #{row.resourceDigest}, #{row.effect}, #{row.challenge}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.safeExplanation}, #{row.matchedRuleId}, #{row.matchedRuleVersion}, #{row.requestDigest}, #{row.requestSchemaVersion}, #{row.requestPayload}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.decidedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT decision_id, snapshot_id, tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, product_id, project_ref, session_ref, run_id, attempt_id, capability, operation, resource_type, resource_ref, resource_digest, effect, challenge, reason_code, safe_explanation, matched_rule_id, matched_rule_version, request_digest, request_schema_version, request_payload, request_hash, decided_at FROM policy_decision WHERE decision_id = #{decisionId}

mapper.select: SELECT request_id, decision_id, semantics, challenge, requester_tenant_id, requester_principal_id, requester_principal_type, target_type, target_id, target_version, target_operation, target_digest, target_safe_summary, authority_provider_id, authority_requirement_id, authority_requirement_version, external_correlation_ref, metadata_schema_version, metadata_payload, metadata_hash FROM approval_request_metadata WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_response_metadata SET authority_outcome = #{outcome}, authority_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, target_outcome = #{outcome}, target_reason_code = #{reasonCode} WHERE response_id = #{responseId} AND authority_outcome = 'PENDING' AND target_outcome = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT decision_id, request_digest, requester_tenant_id, requester_principal_id, requester_principal_type, responder_tenant_id, responder_principal_id, responder_principal_type, approved_at, expires_at FROM policy_authorization_evidence WHERE decision_id = #{decisionId}
mapper.sql: grant_id, semantics, reuse_scope, tenant_id, requester_principal_id, requester_principal_type, product_id, capability, operation, target_type, target_id, target_version, target_operation, target_digest, target_safe_summary, session_ref, project_ref, project_trust_ref, authorization_configuration_digest, source_decision_id, source_approval_request_id, source_approval_response_id, responder_tenant_id, responder_principal_id, responder_principal_type, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason_code, consumed_at, state, version
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_grant SET state = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = #{consumedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE grant_id = #{grantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND state = 'ACTIVE' AND reuse_scope = 'ONCE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{consumedAt})

UPDATE approval_grant SET state = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, revocation_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, version = version + 1 WHERE grant_id = #{grantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND state = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_trust ( trust_id, tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, project_ref, canonical_project_identity, trusted_root_identity, authorization_configuration_digest, product_profile_ref, state, confirmed_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason_code, version ) VALUES ( #{row.trustId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.principalId}, #{row.principalType}, #{row.projectRef}, #{row.canonicalProjectIdentity}, #{row.trustedRootIdentity}, #{row.authorizationConfigurationDigest}, #{row.productProfileRef}, #{row.state}, #{row.confirmedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.revokedAt}, #{row.revocationReasonCode}, #{row.version} )
mapper.select: SELECT trust_id, tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, project_ref, canonical_project_identity, trusted_root_identity, authorization_configuration_digest, product_profile_ref, state, confirmed_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason_code, version FROM project_trust WHERE trust_id = #{trustId}
